neural-cppi lab

The network learns when to risk it.

A neural network learns dynamic allocation across SPY, TLT, GLD and cash, guarding a floor under wealth while costs eat every rebalance. The demo policies below are small and trained live for this page. The published numbers come from the full experiments.

What the network learned

The policy maps time left, cushion above the floor, and recent volatility to a risky weight. A higher floor means less cushion, so the network de-risks earlier. Read the three panels left to right and watch the green collapse toward the bottom.
